Large-scale benchmark of MC-PDFT/NEVPT2 over the 542 vertical excitations of QUESTDB using the APC ranked-orbital automated active-space selection scheme. No row is extractable: the main text reports only aggregate statistics (mean absolute errors by active space and basis: SA-CASSCF ~0.39 +/- 0.03 eV once poor spaces are filtered), never a specific compound paired with a specific active space - the per-molecule APC-generated spaces live in the SI data files. Protocol worth remembering even though it yields no row: candidate orbitals are the up to 23 highest doubly occupied and 23 lowest virtual HF orbitals, symmetry-grouped and Boys-localized, ranked by approximated orbital entropies from diagonal Fock and exchange matrix elements, then pruned lowest-entropy-first until the CSF count hits a cap; singly occupied orbitals get the maximum entropy. Uniform sizes (12,12), (10,10), (8,8) were applied across the whole database, and a 1.1 eV SA-CASSCF error threshold was used post hoc to discard the 20-40 percent of automatically chosen spaces that were poor.

TTF+ radical cation: CAS(13,10) all-pi space with explicit sufficiency test against CAS(21,14) (added S lone pairs give only dipole-forbidden n->pi*); MC-RPA vs SA-CASSCF vs NEVPT2 against measured UV/Vis

Ni(II) triazole complex (231 atoms) from the same paper: deliberate CAS(2,2) eg-only space per ligand-field picture, with CAS(8,5) full-d-shell rejected because t2g NOONs are exactly 2.0 and convergence is slow — a useful negative result for octahedral d8
Usable despite being a method paper: two real compounds (TTF+, Ni(II) triazole complex) each with explicitly justified and explicitly tested active spaces. Two rows extracted.

Difluoromethane (CH2F2) photoelectron spectrum reappraisal. CASSCF is used (state-averaged, for conical intersections and Franck-Condon profiles) but its ACTIVE SPACE IS NEVER SPECIFIED anywhere — no (nel,norb), no orbital list, no full-valence statement; grep for any CAS(n,m) or orbital-count phrasing returns nothing. The quantitative results (AIEs, VIEs, geometries) come from MP4SDQ and EOM-IP-CCSD. Fails the scope test.

Perspective (review) article: 'CAS without SCF - Why to use CASCI and where to get the orbitals'. Discusses the class of CASCI alternatives to CASSCF and where to source orbitals, citing others' results throughout rather than reporting an original multireference calculation on a specific compound. The few (2,2)/(16,16) figures are illustrative of method scaling, not calculations performed here. Per policy, reviews citing others' numbers are not usable.

s-trans-butadiene (4,4) terminal twist: documents the SA-CASSCF discontinuity pathology when an unaveraged state (S4) crosses an averaged one (S3), and the DWS dynamical-weighting remedy with first analytical gradients. Transferable state-averaging guidance.
Usable: real molecule with explicit (4,4) space and a concrete, transferable state-averaging pathology + remedy, rather than a pure algorithm benchmark. One row extracted.

Authorea abstract-only deposit, but the abstract itself states the compound (Na13+), the active space CASSCF(12,12), the method (CASPT2), the basis (cc-pVTZ*), spin states S=0,1,2 with relative energies, and the vertical IE. One partial row; most schema fields unstated because the manuscript body is a hosted file not in the PDF.

CASSCF/CASPT2 study of [UO2(CO3)3]4- (U(VI), 12/12 active space) and [UO2(CO3)3]5- (U(V), 13/13), plus the bare UO2 2+ / UO2+ cations as controls. Active spaces, basis sets, ECPs, software (MOLCAS 5) and optimized bond distances all explicitly stated; SOC explicitly not included. 4 rows.

CASSCF/CASPT2 study of neptunyl carbonate complexes in water. Eight distinct species with explicit active spaces: mono- (10/12), bis- (10/12, also 2/7) and tris-carbonate at Np(V) (10/12 with Na+ counterions), Np(VI) (13/13) and Np(VII) (12/12), plus the bare NpO2+ (14/14), NpO2 2+ (13/13) and NpO2 3+ (12/12) cations. The paper gives an unusually explicit active-space buildup protocol including the occupation-number-based reduction of (14,14) to (10,12). 8 rows.

All-electron DK CASSCF/CASPT2 plus CASSI spin-orbit study of UO2, UO2+ and UO2 2+. Active spaces fully stated ((2,8) and (14,14) for UO2, (1,7) and (13,13) for UO2+, (12,12) for UO2 2+), with an explicit buildup rationale and state-averaging counts. Ground state assigned as (5f)(7s) 3Phi_u Omega=2, r=1.77 A, with vibrational frequencies matched to neon-matrix experiment. 3 rows.

CASSCF/CASPT2 + spin-orbit study of the diactinides Ac2, Th2, Pa2 and U2. Each has an explicitly reasoned active space — (6,18) for Ac2 after (6,12) gave discontinuous curves, (8,12) for Th2, (10,16) for Pa2, (6,20) for U2 with the strong bonding/antibonding pairs frozen out — plus effective bond orders, full spin-free and spin-orbit level tables and bond energies. 4 rows.

CASSCF(10,10) study of the H2SiN+ ion with the full valence active space listed orbital by orbital (7400 CSFs, 3A2), plus FOCI/SOCI single points. Geometry, rotational constants, scaled IR frequencies, dipole and electronic spectrum all reported. Metal-free main-group species, in scope per the 2026-07-14 user decision. 1 row.

CASSCF study of five (H,N,Si) species with the active space written out orbital by orbital for each: HNSi (10,9), HSiN (10,9), HSiNH2 (12,11), H2SiNH (12,11) and HSiNH+ (10,10) in singlet and triplet. CSF counts, reference weights, geometries, dipoles and scaled rotational constants all reported. OCR of a scanned page, so only unambiguous numbers were transcribed. 5 rows.

Real compound (S4 2+) with a stated active space, but the CASSCF is a deliberately minimal (2,2) two-configuration treatment applied only near the transition state on a 3-21G* basis, and the authors themselves say higher-level MCSCF/MRCI is needed for reliable numbers. Row is useful for the barrier-lowering result but most electronic-structure fields are absent. 1 row.

CASSCF/CASPT2 [6,5] and [12,10] (3d double-shell) study of [Fe(H2O)6]2+ high-spin 5T2g vs low-spin 1A1g, used as the ab initio reference for a DFT functional benchmark. Active spaces, buildup rationale, frozen-orbital count, software, basis sets, optimized geometries and the full LS-HS energy table are all stated, including the atomic-asymptote shift procedure. 1 row.

1993 Geneva doctoral thesis; Chapter I is a full-valence CASSCF(13,10) plus FOCI/SOCI study of the H2NO aminoxyl radical with an unusually explicit active-space buildup (internal-set partitions [5], [4,9], [2,2,9] and finally [13]) and the conclusion that the aminoxyl group is an irreducible 9-electron unit. Remaining chapters are MM/MD on carbohydrates and fullerenes, out of scope. Heavy OCR damage, so only unambiguous numbers transcribed. 1 row.

Full-valence CASSCF/RASSCF/MRCI study of C2 high-spin sigma states. Real compound and a determinate full-valence (8,8) space, plus an unusually clear RASSCF protocol (pi occupations pinned to remove pi bonding). But the preprint has no computational-details section: no basis set, no software, no numerical active space anywhere, and an SI fetch found nothing. 1 partial row.

CASSCF/CASPT2 and XMCQDPT2 study of free-base porphine B->Q internal conversion. Three active spaces stated — (4,4) Gouterman, (8,6) extended Gouterman, (10,10) for XMCQDPT2 — with software (MOLCAS 8.0, Firefly), bases (6-31G*, ANO-RCC-VDZ), a full vertical-excitation table against experiment and the conical-intersection mechanism. 1 row.

CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO study of three air-stable pseudo-D5h Dy(III) SIMs differing only in halide counter-anion. Explicit CAS(9,7), 21 sextet roots from 6H15/2, MOLCAS 8.2, per-element ANO-RCC contractions, DKH, plus g tensors, Kramers-doublet spans and Ucal for each complex. 3 rows.

ChemRxiv preprint on oriented-external-electric-field tuning of Ln(III) SIMs. Genuinely a CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO study of real complexes ([Dy(Py)5(OtBu)2]+, [Er{N(SiMe3)2}3Cl]-, [Dy(CpMe3)Cl]) with Ucal values reported, but the deposited PDF has no computational-details section — it defers to an ESI that is not in the file, and a figshare/PMC SI fetch returned nothing. No active space, basis set or software version is stated anywhere in the available text.

ChemRxiv preprint on MOF encapsulation of a dysprosocenium SIM. CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO in MOLCAS 8.2 with Ucal values (1390.9 and 1399.6 cm-1) reported, but the active space is never stated: the text points to 'see computational details' and that section is in an ESI not included in the deposited PDF; a figshare/PMC SI fetch returned nothing.

CASSCF/NEVPT2 study of the CuCN + O2 mechanism for C-N cleavage. Explicit CAS(19,11) for intermediates 7a, 8a and 9a with the orbital composition spelled out (five Cu 3d, O2 pi/pi*, O2 sigma/sigma*), and a state-averaged CAS(18,11) at MECP-1b with its own composition. ORCA 4.0.1, def2-TZVP, ZORA, Pipek-Mezey initial orbitals. 9a and MECP-1b are genuinely multireference; 7a and 8a are not. 4 rows.

[Co(TPP)]-catalyzed carbene transfer study. NEVPT2-CASSCF calculations are reported on the IT and IE-T carbene-radical intermediates and their conclusions are stated (doublet ground state, no significant multireference character), but every computational parameter is deferred to the Supporting Information: the active space, basis and program for the multireference part appear nowhere in the deposited PDF, and a figshare/PMC SI fetch returned nothing. The DFT parameters that are given (BP86/def2-TZVP, B3LYP/ZORA-def2-TZVPP) do not describe the CASSCF.

CASSCF/NEVPT2 + QDPT study of seven Yb(III) solvates. Explicit CAS(13,7) over the 4f manifold, ROKS starting orbitals, ORCA 4.2, SARC2-DKH-QZVP/DKH-def2-TZVP, DKH2, RI-JK, with Yb-O distances for every solvate and crystal-field splittings for the two aqua ions in the main text. Per-solvate microstate tables are in an SI not included in the PDF. 7 rows.

NEVPT2-CASSCF study of three Co-porphyrin radicals: carbene CAS(11,10), mono-nitrene CAS(13,10), bis-nitrene CAS(13,10). Active-space composition, main-contributor weights, spin densities, bond orders and doublet/quartet gaps all stated, with the bis-nitrene coming out quartet-ground unlike the other two. 3 rows.

CASSCF study of hydrogen end-capped carbon wires HC2nH (n=2-12) - metal-free organic polyynes, in scope. CAS(12,12), 6-31G*, GAUSSIAN 03/MOLPRO all stated. Self-published Zenodo preprint (Buckley, 'Topological Active Space C/T Skeleton'). Proposes a topological active-space pre-screening scheme, verified only by FCI on 10 tiny molecules in STO-3G (H2, LiH, BeH2, H2O, N2, C2H2 and stretched variants). Method/algorithm paper whose systems are toy benchmarks in a minimal basis, with no real compound carrying a chemically meaningful active space -> not_usable per the toy-systems rule. Provenance also unverified: v0.1, no peer review, cites mainly the author's own Zenodo deposits.

Self-published Zenodo preprint (Buckley, 'Grassmannian Compression'). A single two-electron toy system in a minimal basis -> not_usable per the toy-systems rule.

Self-published SSRN preprint (Patrascu, 'SpectralXC'). Benchmarks a CASSCF-tile + NEVPT2-resolvent construction over H2, LiH, HF, H2O, N2, CH4, LiF, O2, CH2 and some transition metals, but every active space is generated automatically by an AVAS 'atlas' lookup and no per-molecule (nel,norb) is tabulated in the text - the active space is exactly the quantity this database records. Small benchmark molecules in a method paper with unstated active spaces -> not_usable.

Self-published preprint (Patrascu, Profunctor-CASSCF) but with genuine active-space content: Cr2 at a chemistry-valence CAS(12,12) on {3d,4s}, AVAS-anchored at 1.68 A with Loewdin orbital transport to other geometries, def2-TZVP/X2C/PySCF, and a five-component binding-energy decomposition summing to 1.478 eV vs experiment 1.530 eV. Mo2 gets the manifold {4d,5s,5p} but no numeric active space. Partial: not peer reviewed, Mo2 nel/norb unstated, and Cr2/Mo2 are bare dimers which sit at the edge of the post-2026-07-23 diatomic exclusion - flagged in the row notes. 2 rows.

CASSCF study of Re-Re bonding in Re2(mu-dppm)(S2CNEt2)4 across three oxidation states, with the active space resized on a fixed metal-based manifold: CAS(10,8), CAS(9,8), CAS(8,8). ORCA 5.0, def2-TZVP/def2-SVP-C, RIJCOSX, geometries at BP86-D3BJ/SARC-ZORA-TZVP. Effective bond orders, leading-configuration weights and comparison to Mayer/NBO all stated. 3 rows.

CAS(4,3) study of biradical character in a phosphonium-substituted diphosphaindenylide, run twice (localized orbitals for Lewis-structure weights, natural orbitals for the beta-index of 12%), with CAS(2,2)/CAS(10,9) checks in the SI. Metal-free main-group compound, in scope. ORCA. 1 row.

CASSCF/MS-CASPT2 study proposing the nitranion as intermediate in azide decomposition. CAS(16,15) written out fragment by fragment, MOLCAS 8.6, ANO-RCC with stated contraction, IPEA 0.25, imaginary shift 0.1, SOC between S0 and T0. All critical structures CASSCF-optimized. 1 row covering the reaction sequence.

Primarily a DFT study of three heterocyclic N-oxide photoisomerizations, with CASSCF(6,6)/6-31+G(d,p) used specifically to locate the conical intersections that resolve a DFT/experiment disagreement. Active space size and basis stated; no orbital composition and no software named for the CASSCF step, hence partial. 3 rows.

CASSCF(8,10)/def2-SVP study of a Cope rearrangement bifurcation in 3,4-divinylcyclobut-1-ene, with MRMP2(8,10)/def2-TZVP single points and CASSCF(8,8) direct dynamics. Active-space selection rationale and the deliberate (8,10)->(8,8) reduction for MD are both stated. GAMESS 2022 R1 + ORCA 5.0. 1 row.

CASSCF/6-311++G** conical-intersection seam study of cytosine (Procedia CS conference paper). Active space given by orbital composition - 4 occupied (two pi, two lone pairs) + 5 virtual (three pi*, two sigma*) - so (8,9); Gaussian 09. Partial: a short conference paper, the electron count is arithmetic from the orbital description rather than printed, and conical-intersection energies are not tabulated. 1 row.

Joint experiment/theory study of 5-fluorocytosine vs cytosine singlet excited-state dynamics at CASSCF/CAS-PT2/6-31G* (Gaussian 03 + MOLCAS 5.2). Two numeric active spaces stated in the main text - (8,7) for the (nN,pi*)/S0 decay barrier and (8,8) for the C-F dissociation barrier - plus measured spectra, quantum yield and Stokes shift. 2 rows.

CASPT2//CASSCF study of triplet population in 8-azaadenine with an exemplary active-space protocol: full pi+n would be CAS(20,14) and is declared infeasible, so (18,13) is used for energies, (16,12) for geometries after moving the NH2-localized pi orbital inactive on occupation-number grounds, and (12,10) for the 1(pipi)* MEPs. MOLCAS 7.4, ANO-L DZP with stated contractions, AMFI SOC, PCM, imaginary shift 0.2, no IPEA. 1 row.

Trigonal prismatic Co(II) clathrochelate SMM. Main text defers everything to the SI, but the 'si' command successfully fetched ja5b05739_si_001.pdf, which gives CAS(7,5) over the five Co 3d MOs, ROHF natural-orbital starting guess, 10 quadruplet + 40 doublet state averaging, ORCA 3.0.3, def2-TZVPP/def2-TZVP, RIJCOSX, NEVPT2 and MRCI-based SOC, plus the state-energy table. Textbook case for fetching SI before discarding. 1 row.

Mn18-ring exchange study. CAS(12,15) on the (Mn(III),S=2)3 subunit stated in the main text, with the Mn->Ga diamagnetic-substitution strategy for extracting pairwise couplings and a direct fit to the computed S=0..6 ladder. ORCA, CASSCF/NEVPT2 plus broken-symmetry DFT. Basis and remaining protocol are SI-only. 1 row.

THz-EPR plus CASSCF/CASPT2/RASSI-SO study of Co(NCX)2 (X = S, Se) chains, using [CoZn2(NCX)4(py)2]2+ models with Zn substitution for the neighbouring Co. Genuinely relevant work with POLY_ANISO spin-ring modelling, but the active space is stated nowhere: the Computational details section names the method chain and the DFT geometry level (RI-BP86/def2-SVP, Turbomole 7.6) but never a (nel,norb), no basis set for the CASSCF step, and an exhaustive grep finds no active-space specification anywhere in the text. A figshare/PMC SI fetch returned nothing.

CASSCF/CASPT2/MC-PDFT/HMC-PDFT study of five (C6F5)3trenV(III) optically addressable qubit candidates. Active spaces stated per compound: (2,5) 3d-only for all, plus (6,9) adding ligand pi/pi* for compounds 1-3 and (4,7) adding sigma/sigma* for 4-5, with a (2,5)/(6,9)/(2,10) double-d-shell convergence check on compound 1. Ten triplet / seven singlet roots, RASSI SOC, singlet-triplet gaps and ZFS D/E tabulated, AILFT-NEVPT2 d-orbital orderings. 5 rows.

SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2/QD-NEVPT2 study of four Co SMMs with spin-phonon coupling. Active space sized by electron count - CAS(7,5) for the d7 complexes 1 and 4, CAS(8,5) for the d8 complexes 2 and 3 - with an explicit two-stage root treatment (10 quartets/40 doublets for orbital optimization reduced to 7/28 in the CI step; 10 triplets/15 singlets reduced to 7/5). ORCA 5.0, def2-TZVP/AUTOAUX, QDPT-SOMF, effective Hamiltonian for g/D/E. 4 rows.

Fe(III) porphyrin magneto-structural study with an exemplary active-space expansion ladder: CAS(5e,5o) d-only is shown to be quantitatively wrong (quartet-sextet gap 9396 cm-1, D = 2.06 cm-1), then a pi-type ligand orbital -> CAS(7e,6o), the diffuse 4d shell -> CAS(7e,11o), and a sigma-type ligand orbital -> CAS(9e,12o), bringing D to 7.85 cm-1 and the gap to 2749 cm-1. Plus a temperature series (D 7.85 -> 10.08 cm-1 across 100/250/295 K structures). ORCA 5.0, ZORA, full basis specification, AILFT. 1 row.

CASSCF/CASPT2/RASSI study of idealised YbFx and ErFx model series asking why trigonal planar Yb(III) fails as a zero-field SMM. Both active spaces stated with their state averages - CAS(13,7) over 7 doublets for Yb, CAS(11,7) over 35 quartets and 112 doublets for Er - plus fixed Ln-F bond lengths and an explicit battery of controls (bond-length swap, basis-contraction swap, cross-metal orbital reuse) to exclude numerical artefacts. OpenMolcas, ANO-RCC, DKH2, AMFI, PHI. 2 rows.

DMRG-CASSCF study of 17 nonheme iron nitrosyls spanning Enemark-Feltham {FeNO}6-10 plus two bis-nitrosyls. Table 1 gives an individual 'ne in na' for every complex (13-22 electrons in 18-25 orbitals) built from one uniform recipe: all Fe 3d, all available Fe 4d for the double shell, all Fe-ligand sigma, plus a ten-orbital NO set per nitrosyl. CheMPS2 1.8.12 + OpenMolcas 11.9, def2-TZVP, Cholesky 1e-6, m=1000 validated at 1500, CSF weights binned into Fe-NO resonance forms. 17 rows.

Companion DMRG-CASSCF/CASPT2 study of heme nitrosyls, {FeNO}6-8. Same uniform active-space recipe as the nonheme paper, with per-complex and notably per-spin-state sizes from Table 1 (e.g. Fe[P](NO) is 19 in 23 as a quartet but 19 in 22 as a doublet). OpenMolcas+CheMPS2, aug-cc-pwCV5Z-DK on Fe, DKH2, frozen Fe 3s/3p in CASPT2, imaginary shift 0.1. 7 rows, condensed one per compound with both spin states recorded.

CASSCF study of the isostructural MBr3(OPcy3)3 series (M = Ce, Nd, Am) probing the inverse trans influence. Active space stated as CAS(n,7) over the seven metal f orbitals with n = 1, 3, 6 by f-electron count; ORCA 4.1.1, SARC-TZVP/def2-TZVP, scalar relativistic, crystal-structure geometries used unoptimized on purpose. QTAIM |V(r)|/G(r) ratios tabulated per bond. Noted an internal inconsistency: the text refers once to 'SR-CAS(7,7)' which contradicts the stated CAS(n,7) - left unresolved rather than guessed. 3 rows.

CASPT2 and RASSCF/RASPT2 study of a uranium bis(anthracenide) sandwich dimer with an exemplary staged active-space reduction: (4e,14o) all 5f -> (4e,8o) after finding most 5f unoccupied by crystal-field effects -> RASSCF (2e,2h,2e;10o,8o,10o) to carry 10 pi/pi* pairs beyond CASSCF's reach -> final (8e,12o) justified by RAS1 occupations >=1.96 and RAS3 <=0.04. OpenMolcas. Notably the paper declines to assign a spin ground state, the singlet/triplet/quintet lying within 0.3 kcal/mol. 1 row (the K-contacted congener has no separate active space).

CASSCF/CASPT2 study of a neutral uranium bis(anthracenide) sandwich (1) and its ring-migrated isomer (3). The paper reports real multireference results - CASPT2 triplet/quintet energetics (quintet geometry lower by 3.2 and 2.9 kcal/mol in 1 and 3) and CASSCF natural-orbital occupations showing purely pi U-C bonding - but says only 'see SI for details of active space choice' and never prints a numeric (nel,norb); a figshare/PMC SI fetch found nothing. No row added: without an active space the row would carry nothing this database exists to hold.

CORRECTION to the extracted_partial mark set moments earlier, which was wrong because no row was added. CASSCF/CASPT2 study of a neutral uranium bis(anthracenide) sandwich (1) and its ring-migrated isomer (3), with real multireference results (CASPT2 quintet geometry lower by 3.2 and 2.9 kcal/mol; CASSCF occupations showing purely pi U-C bonding), but the active space is specified nowhere - the text says only 'see SI for details of active space choice' and the SI is not in the deposited PDF nor fetchable from figshare/PMC. Per the standing rule, an active space never specified at all is not_usable.

SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2 study of 15 Fe(III) trigonal-bipyramidal complexes. Excellent active-space justification: minimal CAS(5,5) gives the WRONG ground spin state for the parent complex 2, so the two axial group-15 pz orbitals and their four electrons are added to give CAS(9,7), used throughout; state-averaged over 21 sextet, 224 quartet, 490 doublet roots. Also documents that SS-CASSCF wrongly favours high spin where SA-CASSCF gets intermediate spin right. ORCA, def2-TZVPP, B3LYP-D3BJ geometries. 2 rows (parent complex plus the designed substitution series); per-complex D values left in the paper's tables.

NEVPT2-CASSCF study of Co(TAML) redox non-innocence. Three complexes with individually determined spaces - (14,13) for the anionic TAMLred complex, (13,12) for the neutral TAMLsq radical, (14,13) for the bis-nitrene - all built from 'all Co d + interacting ligand pi (+ nitrene p)' then pruned of orbitals converging to occupancy 2.00. That pruning is why nominally similar complexes get different sizes: dxy removed in one, both dz2 and dxy in another. Loewdin populations, occupations and CASSCF excitation assignments all reported. 3 rows.

CASSCF analysis of C-H activation by high-valent Mn-oxo species. CAS(4,5) for the d4 Mn(III)=O and CAS(3,5) for the d3 Mn(IV)=O, both validated by expansion to CAS(9,8) adding two oxo p-pi and one oxo p-sigma orbital. The multireference result is the paper's mechanistic conclusion: greater excited-configuration mixing into the ground configuration lowers the HAT barrier, demonstrated across the transition-state series. ORCA 4.0.1 / Gaussian 09, def2-TZVP. The Fe analogues are treated by DFT/SNO with no separate active space reported, so no rows for them. 2 rows.

Photochemistry of four Ni(II) tolyl chloride complexes. CASSCF/QD-NEVPT2 in ORCA 5.0.3 is applied to complex 4 to model quasi-degenerate ground and low-lying excited states, but no active space is stated anywhere: an exhaustive grep finds only the spelled-out method name and no (nel,norb), and a figshare/PMC SI fetch returned nothing. Everything quantitative in the paper (HOMO-LUMO gaps, absorption spectra) comes from DFT/TDDFT at TPSSh/def2-TZVP, which does not describe the CASSCF.

CASSCF study of (L)RuV=O and (L)RuV=N intermediates with a clean two-tier AVAS-built active space: CAS(9e,8o) from Ru(4d) alone, extended by the X(2p) orbitals to CAS(13e,10o) for most compounds and CAS(15e,11o) for two. Explicitly situated against the literature CAS(12,12) and CAS(8,8) treatments of [Re2Cl8]2-, which agreed on EBO 3.20. ORCA 5.0, def2-TZVP, DFT-OLYP geometry at Re-Re 2.20 A. 2 rows.

CASSCF study of LMCT transitions in four (t2g)5 boronated cyanometallates (Fe-III, Ru-III, Os-III, Mn-II BCF). CASSCF/NEVPT2 + AILFT study of heterometallic CuCd/Cu2Zn complexes with three active-space sizes for different questions: CAS(9,5) Cu 3d for the AILFT d-orbital energies and g-matrix, CAS(9,10) as a 4d double-shell check (found not to matter), CAS(18,10) over both coppers' 3d for the dinuclear exchange, plus a minimal CAS(2,2) SORCI benchmark. ORCA 5.0.4, DKH-def2/SARC-DKH bases. Also candidly reports DDCI2 vs DDCI3 giving J = 354 vs 6 cm-1 against an experimental -130.1 cm-1. 1 row.

SA-CASSCF study of spin-vibrational coupling and blocking temperature in a Dy(III) SMM. Active space stated as nine 4f electrons in seven 4f orbitals, with a graded basis (VDZP first coordination sphere, VDZ beyond), MOLCAS 8.2 + Gaussian 09. Partial: no root counts and no per-complex numerical results in the extracted main text. 1 row.

[ECCE]-coordinated (E = P, As) ruthenium complexes across Ru(I)/Ru(II)/Ru(III). Every computational parameter is deferred with 'see SI for technical details'; no active space, no (nel,norb), and only def2-TZVP and ORCA/Dalton names appear in the text. A figshare/PMC SI fetch returned nothing.

SA-CASSCF study of magnetic anisotropy and luminescence thermometry in three Dy(III) beta-diimine complexes. VIEH-framework decomposition of magnetic coupling J in mu-oxo-bridged metal complexes using 'differently sized complete active space approaches'. ORCA 5.0.3, def2-TZVP are the only concrete parameters given.

CASSCF study of heterometallic Ln-Pd organometallics with short Ln-Pd distances. CASSCF(9,12) is stated for one compound, where the 9 electrons populate only Cp*-based antibonding orbitals and a dense set of orbitals below the active space carries mixed Pd 4d / Yb 4f character - the paper's main finding being that no significant Pd-Ln orbital interaction exists. Partial: active spaces for compounds 4 and 5 are deferred to the ESI, which is not available, so only the (9,12) case is captured. No row added separately for the second compound.

CASPT2//CASSCF study of nitrobenzene. Three active-space tiers by task: CASSCF(14,11) (ring pi plus oxygen lone pairs) for final verticals, reduced state-dependent spaces for optimizations, and (16,13) for photoreactivity. MOLCAS 8, ANO-L with stated contraction, imaginary shift 0.2. 1 row.

LR-CASSCF vs SA-CASSCF excitation energies for the flavin/fatty-acid chromophore in a polarizable QM/AMOEBA environment. Documents a failure of automatic active-space selection: the UNO procedure returned CAS(8,8) omitting the carboxylate pi orbital essential to the chemistry, so manual CAS(14,8) and CAS(14,11) spaces were built instead, with orbital composition given. 1 row.

CASSCF linear-response X-ray absorption method paper applied to real species with fully stated active spaces: CAS(24,17) (all Mn 3d + all O 2p) for MnO4- CASSCF/MCRPA with a reduced CAS(8,9) (O 1s + Mn 3d) for the CVS-CASCI step, plus the general core-orbital rotation recipe giving CAS(7,6) for K-edge and CAS(11,8) for L/M-edge from a CAS(5,5) reference. ORCA 4.0, custom def2-QZVPP. 1 row.

CASSCF-SO study of asymmetric Er(III)/Yb(III) lanthanide dimetallics. Active spaces stated as 11 and 13 electrons in seven 4f orbitals with 35 quartet / 112 doublet states for Er. MOLCAS 8.0, graded ANO-RCC basis (VTZP ion / VDZP first sphere / VDZ beyond), unoptimized XRD geometries. 2 rows.

Spectroscopy plus CASSCF/NEVPT2 on Mn(IV)-oxo complexes, and one of the clearest active-space cautionary cases yet: d-only CAS(3,5) gives a doublet ground state even after NEVPT2 against an EPR-established quartet; the quartet-doublet gap grows monotonically with active-space size; CAS(11,9) adding the oxo p-pi/p-sigma and Mn-N sigma-bonding MOs gives best agreement. Also an honest negative result - CAS(11,15) still fails for [MnIV(O)(OH)(Me2EBC)]+. ORCA 3.0.3. 2 rows.

CASSCF-SO electronic structures of heavy lanthanide metallocenium cations, Gd through Yb. Main text defers to the SI; the si command fetched ja7b11535_si_001.pdf whose Table S8 gives per-ion 4f electron counts in the seven f orbitals with full root and spin-orbit state counts (e.g. Dy 9 electrons, 21/224/490 roots, 21/128/130 SO states). CAS(4,4) MCSCF on toluene and p-cresol as tractable analogues of the tyrosine side chain, with ground and first-excited-singlet geometries and frequencies. IUPAC Pure and Applied Chemistry review on the electronic structure of higher acenes and polyacene. The CASSCF/DMRG results discussed (all pi electrons in all pi orbitals, up to dodecacene, on UB3LYP/6-31G* geometries) are Hachmann et al.'s work being summarised, not the authors' own calculations. Vibrational spectra of N,N-dimethylaniline and its radical cation. Molecular chirality and parity violation: CASSCF (and random-phase) wavefunctions are used to compute the parity-violating potential Vpv, but the paper explicitly refers the reader elsewhere for all details ('Details can be found elsewhere') and states no active space, basis or program. Photoelectron spectroscopy of O- + acetone products interpreted with CASPT2/aug-cc-pVTZ//(4/4)CASSCF on oxyallyl. Partial: the active space appears only as '(4/4)' in the level-of-theory string with no orbital composition given. 1 row.

CASPT2//CASSCF study of the adenine-thymine base pair. CAS(12,12) restricted to the a'' pi manifold in Cs (six pi + six pi*), ANO basis with stated contractions, MOLCAS 7.4, plus a RASPT2 cross-check putting the whole pi space in the restricted space with up to quadruple excitations (agreeing with CASPT2 to <0.1 eV). 1 row.

CASPT2//CASSCF relaxation mechanisms of 6-azauracil. Two-tier active space stated: CASSCF(16/11) (all pi/pi* plus three lone pairs) for energies with CASPT2(16/11) single points, and the reduced pi-only CASSCF(10/8) for minimum energy paths. 1 row.

IUPAC proceedings reporting the authors' OWN QM/MM CASPT2//CASSCF work on nucleobases (not a review of others' numbers): (14,10) full pi plus two in-plane O/N lone pairs with CASPT2 IPEA=0.25/ANO-L 431/21, and CASSCF(12,12)/ANO-S 321/21 for a stacked cytosine dimer with an explicit orbital-exclusion rule (drop the NH2-localized pi MOs and the deep all-in-phase combinations). 2 rows.

Constrained CASSCF(2,2) for molecule-metal electron transfer in Li(2n+1)-Cl clusters, with the active-space population on the molecule constrained to unity so the space spans both donor and acceptor. Recorded for its explicit three-part argument AGAINST enlarging the active space (exponential cost, proliferating CASSCF solutions giving discontinuous surfaces, and HF-like exchange failing to stabilize a metal) - a rare documented case for staying minimal. 1 row.

CASPT2//CASSCF relaxation mechanisms of 5-azacytosine at CAS(14,10)/ANO-L DZP in MOLCAS 7.6. Exemplary active-space transfer: the established cytosine CAS(12,9) (which omits the amino-group pi orbital) is taken and expanded by exactly the lone pair introduced by the new N5 nitrogen. 1 row.

HAB79 benchmark dataset (79 molecules, 921 dimer configurations) for electronic couplings. Minimal active space stated explicitly - two orbitals with three electrons for p-type carriers, two orbitals with one electron for n-type - state-averaged over two doublets per dimer, validated against MRCI+Q with a CAS(11,10) reference in C2v/aug-cc-pVTZ. ORCA 4.2.0. Recorded as a benchmark-set row: the documented adequacy of a minimal (3,2) space is the transferable content. 1 row.

CASPT2//CASSCF study of triplet population in 6-aza-2-thiothymine at CAS(16,11), MOLCAS 7. Active space fully composed: all pi/pi* except the methyl C-H linear combination (excluded specifically to stabilize the active space along minimum energy paths) plus one lone pair each from N, O and S. 1 row.

Algorithm to correct CASSCF active-space drift across MD geometry ensembles, applied to all five canonical nucleobases in explicit water. Per-nucleobase active spaces and root counts all stated: uracil (14,10)/10 roots, cytosine (14,10)/8, thymine (14,10)/10 with the methyl-localized MO deliberately excluded, adenine (18,13)/11, guanine (20,14)/9. OpenMolcas SA-CASSCF, AMBER18 MD, MP2/6-31G* geometries. Directly relevant premise: the active space is NOT preserved across an ensemble unless corrected. 5 rows.

DMRG/CASSCF study of lutein excited states along the bond-length-alternation coordinate. Major active-space result: the chemically complete CAS(20,20) pi space - independently confirmed by automatic UNO selection - is adequate for the ground state but UNBALANCED for the excited-state manifold, placing the bright state artificially high and destroying the expected crossing sequence. Four deliberately asymmetric spaces with six more virtuals than electrons (CAS(8,14)/(10,16)/(12,18)/(14,20)) were used instead. def2-SVPD. A direct counterexample to 'full valence pi is the safe choice'. 1 row.

One row.

CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO/POLY_ANISO in MOLCAS 8.2 on the {Cu2Ln(HL)4(NO3)}(NO3)2 series, Ln = La, Ce, Pr, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho. Active space and root counts are in the SI only: (9,5) on Cu(II) 3d and (n,7) on each Ln(III) 4f shell with n = 1,2,7,8,9,10 for Ce,Pr,Gd,Tb,Dy,Ho, using diamagnetic substitution (Cu->Zn, Ln->La) to isolate each paramagnetic centre. Seven rows: the copper site plus each paramagnetic lanthanide. Would have been written off as 'no active space stated' without fetching the SI.

Review/tutorial ('Get under the Umbrella: A Comprehensive Gateway for Researchers on Lanthanide-Based Single-Molecule Magnets', Eur. J. Inorg. Chem. 2023). Surveys CASSCF/CASPT2/NEVPT2+RASSI practice for 4f complexes and discusses the limitations of these approaches, but performs no calculation and states no active space.

Angewandte Chemie Review ('Increasing the Magnetic Blocking Temperature of Single-Molecule Magnets'). Discusses CASSCF-type methods and CASPT2/NEVPT2 corrections generally and cites others' results; no calculation of its own, no active space stated.

Review (Chem. Eur. J. 2023) on photochemistry driven by excited-state aromaticity gain or antiaromaticity relief. States explicitly 'in this review we have described...' and 'no new data were created or analyzed in this study'. Recommends CASSCF over anti-Aufbau DFT and quotes NICS values computed at the CASSCF level from cited work, but runs nothing itself and states no active space.

ChemPhysChem 2005 assessment of density functionals for the high-spin/low-spin gap in [Fe(bpy)3]2+. The paper states that the size of this complex 'precludes the use of computationally demanding high-level ab initio (wavefunction-based) methods' and is a DFT benchmarking study; CASSCF/CASPT2/SORCI appear only as comparison levels carried over from the authors' two previous papers on smaller systems, with no active space stated anywhere for the complex studied here.

Molecules 2022 review of excited-state intramolecular proton transfer dyes with dual-state emission. The single CASSCF/CASPT2 occurrence in the text is reference 97 in the bibliography (Li et al., J. Comput. Chem. 2015), not work done here; the paper's own computational content is TD-DFT. No active space stated.

CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS 8) + NEVPT2 (ORCA 3) on three eight-coordinate Co(II) tetranitrate complexes (A)2[Co(NO3)4], A+ = Ph4P+, MePh3P+, Ph4As+. CAS(7,10) with the 3d double-shell (5+5'), orbitals averaged over 10 S=3/2 and 40 S=1/2 roots. Three rows. Table 2 of experimental zfs did not extract cleanly, noted per row.

MOLCAS 8.0 CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO/POLY_ANISO on the pentanuclear {MnIVMnIII2LnIII2} family. Seven rows: five lanthanide sites with (n,7) 4f spaces (Dy 9, Tb 8, Sm 5, Nd 4, Pr 3 electrons) and the two manganese sites at CAS(3,5) for Mn(IV) and CAS(4,5) for Mn(III), each with its own root counts.

CASSCF/NEVPT2 in ORCA 4.0.1 (def2-TZVP) on the Co(II) site of a mixed-valence {CoIII2CoII2}n chain; active space stated in words as seven electrons in five d orbitals, with 10 quartet and 20 doublet excited states via an effective Hamiltonian. One row; best-fit D = +67.0 cm-1.

Serrano-Andres/Merchan/Roos 1993 CASSCF/CASPT2 benchmark on ethene, trans-1,3-butadiene and trans,trans-1,3,5-hexatriene. Active electron counts (2, 4, 6 pi electrons) are stated explicitly; the orbital counts come from summing the per-symmetry active-orbital tuples in Table I, which is partially garbled in the extracted text although self-consistent with the point groups (8 entries for D2h, 4 for C2h). Marked partial and flagged in notes so the sums can be re-checked against the published table. Three rows.

Dunning and Xu, J. Comput. Chem. 2023: electronic structure of Li1,2,3 +,0,- and the nature of bonding in Li2,3 +,0,-. Valence CASSCF(2s,2p) with MRCI/CC and SCGVB analysis in Molpro. Excluded on the same scope convention applied throughout this batch: free atoms, bare diatomics and small bare clusters of a single element are not 'a specific chemical compound'. The active space is also given as an orbital-type label (2s,2p) rather than an (nel,norb) pair. Logged so it converts to rows if the scope rule is relaxed.

Inorg. Chem. 2012 study of the 'blue dimer' water-oxidation catalyst cis,cis-[(bpy)2(H2O)RuIIIORuIII(OH2)(bpy)2]4+. The paper's own computation is DFT (B3LYP, Gaussian 03); the CASSCF/MC-SCF results discussed (10 electrons distributed within the orbital set, singlet ~1000 cm-1 below the triplet) are Batista and Martin's published numbers cited as reference 11, not work performed here. No active space of its own.

CASSCF-SO (OpenMolcas 23.02) run on every 1 fs frame of a 90 ps AIMD trajectory of [DyL1], a PARASHIFT MRI shift agent, to simulate electron spin dynamics in solution. Active space (9,7) with the 18 lowest roots of the S=5/2 manifold (6H and 6F terms), stated in SI Section S2. One row.

CASSCF-SO on the trigonal-planar Tm(II) tris(silylamide) complex 3. SI gives the active space as the seven 4f orbitals populated by the 13 Tm(II) electrons, all 7 doublets in both orbital optimisation and spin-orbit mixing. Ground J=7/2 split over ca. 1300 cm-1 with pure mJ=+/-7/2 ground state. One row.

CASSCF/CASPT2 and RASSCF/RASPT2 (MOLCAS-7, ANO-RCC) on NiBDT, bis(ethylene-1,2-dithiolato)nickel, for linear and nonlinear optical properties. Active space 12/4242 = 12 electrons in 12 MOs (4 sigma, 2 pi, 4 sigma*, 2 pi*) given per C2v symmetry subspace, with documented enlargement to 16/4444 and beyond. 16 excited states. One row.

CAS-srDFT NMR shielding constants with GIAOs in a development version of Dalton, benchmarked against CASSCF, HF-srDFT and DFT. Active spaces chosen from MP2-srPBE natural occupation numbers and printed as (orbitals, electrons): (6,6) adenine, (4,4) thymine, (7,6) TMS. Three rows, with the values transposed to the database's (electrons, orbitals) convention and the reversal flagged in notes.

SO-CASSCF/RASSI study (MOLCAS 7.8, DKH, AMFI) of the origin of the crystal field in rare-earth complexes. Five rows: [PrCl9]6- at (2,7) with 21 triplets and 28 singlets in the SOC step, and model sandwich complexes [Ln(C5H5)2]+, [Ln(C6H6)2]3+, [Ln(C8H8)2]- at CAS(N,7) for Ln = Dy(9), Ho(10), Er(11), Tm(12) with per-ion root counts. Sandwich ligand variants condensed per lanthanide since the active space depends only on 4f^N.

CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO (MOLCAS 8.0) on triangular {CoIII2LnIII(mu3-OMe)}8+ clusters. Computational details state the CAS explicitly: nine electrons across seven 4f orbitals for Dy(III), eight for Tb(III), eleven for Er(III). No diamagnetic substitution needed since the Co(III) ions are already diamagnetic. Three rows.

CAS[14,14] calculations on Cp2Ti(kappa2-tBuNCNtBu), spanning all valence and bonding orbitals of the Ti-N-C-N core, used to settle which of three limiting resonance structures describes the Ti-carbene interaction. Natural orbital occupations HOMO 1.68 / LUMO 0.33 and a Mayer Ti-C bond order of 0.19 from the CASSCF natural orbitals. One row.

Chem. Eur. J. study of halogen substitution effects on N2OS Schiff base ligands in abrupt Fe(II) spin-crossover complexes. Synthetic and structural work with magnetic and crystallographic characterisation; no CASSCF/CASPT2 calculation is performed and no active space is stated anywhere in the text.

Inorganics Review: 'Design and Control of Cooperativity in Spin-Crossover in Metal-Organic Complexes: A Theoretical Overview'. States 'In this review we discuss the recent theoretical progress'; CASSCF and CASPT2 appear in a methods survey and in the abbreviations glossary. No calculation of its own, no active space.

Molecules Review: 'Modern Theoretical Approaches to Modeling the Excited-State Intramolecular Proton Transfer: An Overview'. States 'In this review, we identify and discuss three fundamental families of theoretical approaches'. Describes others' FOMO-CASCI and wavefunction-in-DFT embedding work; performs no calculation and states no active space.

Inorganics comparative study of rare-earth and actinide 2,6-bis(1,2,4-triazin-3-yl)pyridine (BTP) complexes. The paper states its main part is DFT (M062X) with pseudopotential basis sets; the single CASSCF occurrence is a bibliography entry (Kerridge, Dalton Trans. 2013). No multireference calculation performed here, no active space stated.

Coordination Chemistry Reviews article by Harvey, Poli and Smith on the reactivity of transition metal complexes involving multiple spin states. Concludes 'we hope to have shown by this review that the tools for working this out are now available'; CASPT2 results discussed (e.g. for simplified Cr(III) catalyst models) are cited from the literature. No calculation of its own, no active space.

Embedded correlated wavefunction benchmark (MOLPRO 2012.1, DFET embedding) of H2 desorption from and CH4 dissociation on Cu(111), modelled as Cu12 and Cu10 clusters. Exceptionally well documented active-space escalation: (14,14)->(38,38)->(62,62) for H2 and (12,12)->(58,58) for CH4, with the orbital content of each increment stated. Two rows. Included despite being a surface model because the chemical systems are specific and the active-space provenance is unusually complete.

SA-CASSCF in ORCA (TZVP/SVP) on Mn(III) chain coordination polymers with salicylic Schiff base ligands, four electrons in 5 orbitals with 5 quintet and lowest 35 triplet states. Notable for computing the spin-spin contribution to the zfs explicitly via the coupled-perturbed scheme, so ss_included=yes. One row covering compounds 1-8, which share the treatment.

CASSCF-SO on the [Cp'FeI2]- anion (Cp' = 1,2,4-tri(tert-butyl)cyclopentadienyl) with a minimal active space of 6 electrons in the 3d orbitals, confirming a strongly anisotropic S=2 high-spin d6 ground state with a low-lying first excited state. One row.

SA-CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS 5, ANO basis) on 2-aminopurine in vapour and water. Active space stated as 12 electrons in 10 orbitals for the pi,pi* states, enlarged with two a' lone-pair orbitals for the n,pi* states; the (0,10) and (2,10) labels are per-symmetry orbital counts, not (nel,norb) pairs, and that is flagged in the row. One row.

CASSCF (NWChem) on two models of the methylcobalamin-dependent methionine synthase process: (12,12) for the first model and (13,13) for the second, with convergence checked at (14,14), (13,14) and (14,15) and no change in the electronic structure results. Two rows. active_space_orbital_description left empty since the paper never lists which orbitals are in the space.

CASSCF/MS-CASPT2 (MOLCAS 4.1, ANO+Rydberg) survey of conjugated cyclic ketones and thioketones: cyclopropenone, cyclopropenethione, cyclopentadienone, cyclopentadienethione, tropone and thiotropone. Electron counts stated explicitly (6, 6, 12, 12, 10, 10) with orbital counts given as per-C2v-symmetry tuples. Six rows.

CASSCF/CASPT2 on the iron member of the [M(Cat-N-BQ)(Cat-N-SQ)]/[M(Cat-N-BQ)2] valence-tautomer series. CAS[6,7] deliberately sized so the space accommodates both Fe(III) and Fe(II) distributions rather than imposing one; metal_ox_state left empty in the row for exactly that reason. One row.

CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS 7.0) used to spin-purify broken-symmetry DFT for Cu(II)-oxyl/Cu(III)-oxo species from Cu(I)-alpha-ketocarboxylate complexes and O2. The active space is described by orbital content only - the Cu 3d orbitals plus two O2 orbitals, hence 7 orbitals - with no electron count stated anywhere, so active_space_nel is left empty and this is marked partial.

CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO (OpenMolcas) on triangular Dy3 complexes Dy3.Cl, Dy3.Br and Dy3.ClO4 built on a tricompartmental hydrazone ligand. Active space written 'CAS(9 in 7 for DyIII)'; all roots calculated and the maximum number of spin-free states mixed in the SO step. Three rows, one per complex.

Study of sterically encumbered ligands tuning D5h lanthanide single-ion magnets. Performs CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO on the X-ray structures of complexes 1-4, but states no active space anywhere in the main text, and no SI is available via figshare or PMC. Per policy a paper whose active space is never specified is not_usable; retry if the SI becomes reachable.

Chem. Eur. J. study asking whether the sign of the Cu-Gd magnetic interaction depends on the number of atoms in the bridge. Primarily synthetic, structural and magnetic. The CASSCF content is a statement about prior theoretical investigations - that Cu-Gd magnetic behaviour can only be reproduced if the Gd 5d orbitals are included in the active space - cited as established background rather than computed here; no active space of its own is stated.

Methodological paper implementing the Interacting Quantum Atoms partition via coupled-cluster Lagrangian densities. CASSCF appears as one of several wavefunction approximations (alongside HF, FCI and truncated CI) used to test the energy-partition scheme; the systems are small two-electron species used to validate the partition, and no active space is stated for any specific compound.

CASSCF(12,11)/6-31G*/MM with CASPT2(12,11) single points on the RSFP chromophore in QM/MM models of Dronpa, Padron and Dronpa mutants (MOLCAS 7.8 + Tinker). Notable for defining the active space by natural occupation number - all pi orbitals with occupancies not close to 0 or 2 - verified by a dedicated single-point calculation. One row.

CASSCF/NEVPT2 (ORCA 4.0) cross-checked against CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO (MOLCAS 8.0) on dinuclear Co(II)-Y(III) complexes, CAS(7,5) with 10 quartets and 40 doublets. Y(III) is diamagnetic so the anisotropy is single-ion Co(II). Three rows for the complexes whose formulae are fully recoverable from the text.

SA-CASSCF/RASSI-SO/SINGLE_ANISO (OpenMolcas 19.11, ANO-RCC-VTZP) on ten [Dy(OSiF3)3(O(SiF3)2)n] model complexes (CN 3-6) representing Dy(III) sites on silica. Active space (9,7) with an unusually complete root specification: all 21 sextets, all 224 quartets and 250 doublets. One row, condensed since the ten models share one active space.

CASSCF/SA-CASSCF with MRMP and MCQDPT on the phenoxyl/phenol PCET self-exchange (modified GAMESS, MOLPRO 2008.1). Active space stated as eleven electrons in ten active orbitals, four pi/pi* on each aromatic ring; SA over the two lowest states with equal weights to avoid broken symmetry. The state gap at each TS is the diagnostic separating PCET from HAT. One row.

Two active spaces for two purposes on three imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine ESIPT dyes: CASSCF(10,9)/6-31G(d) two-state-averaged for the S0/S1 MECIs, and MS-CASPT2(14,10)/ANO-L for the vertical energies. MOLPRO 2015 and MOLCAS 7.8/OpenMolcas. Three rows, numeric fields carrying the MS-CASPT2 space.

CASPT2 (MOLCAS 7.4, ANO-RCC, Douglas-Kroll) on Fe(II) spin-crossover complexes [Fe(bbpya)(NCS)2] and [Fe(bapbpy)(NCS)2]. Active space (10,12): five 3d plus five 3d' double-shell orbitals plus two ligand sigma orbitals - the textbook SCO space, with the double shell included because the HS/LS gap is sensitive to differential radial correlation. Two rows.

DFT-BS and CASSCF (ORCA, GAUSSIAN 16, ZORA) on metal complexes with stable radical ligands (pyDTDA, imVDZ). Active spaces stated as a spelled-out list then as pairs: (12,7) Cu, (11,7) Ni, (10,7) Co, (9,7) Fe, (8,7) Mn - one fixed seven-orbital set with the electron count tracking the metal dn. Six rows. Nearly missed: the numbers appear as 'twelve, eleven, ten, nine and eight electrons' before the pairs are given.

CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS 7.4, ANO basis) on S-loss and O-loss dissociation of the SO2+ ion in its C, D and E states, using full valence active spaces: 17 active electrons in the 5a1-9a1, 2b1-3b1, 3b2-6b2 and 1a2 orbitals of C2v, i.e. (17,12). One row for SO2+; the related species (O2, SO, SO+, S+, O, O+) are bare diatomics and free atoms, excluded on the standing scope convention.

DODS-MO and CASSCF/UNO-CASMP2/MR-SDCI study of ozone and carbonyl oxide (Criegee intermediate) and ozonolysis mechanisms, GAUSSIAN 94 and HONDO95. Small {2,2} active space spanning the singlet-diradical pair of these tricentric intermediates. Two rows.

CASSCF/MRMP2 on excited-state hydrogen atom transfer in pyrrole-ammonia clusters. The active space is specified by orbital content - five pi orbitals of pyrrole plus the lowest unoccupied sigma*, hence 6 orbitals - with the sigma* included because it is the dissociative orbital along N-H, but the electron count is never stated, so active_space_nel is left empty and this is marked partial.

CASSCF/MCSCF spin-spin coupling constants of acetylene and its complexes with water, acetonitrile, acetone and benzene, with PCM solvent (local DALTON build). The CAS space is 12 active orbitals with C 1s inactive, chosen to match the CAS1 space of the earlier work being revisited; no electron count is stated, so active_space_nel is left empty and this is marked partial.

Two-state three-mode parameterisation of the force field of PSB3, the penta-2,4-dieniminium retinal chromophore model. Real XMCQDPT2//CASSCF/6-31G* data underlie the fit, but the paper states only the basis set and method label - the active space size appears nowhere in the text, and the CASSCF data are taken from the authors' earlier mapping work. No active space stated, so not_usable; would convert to rows if the size were recoverable from the cited source.

Full-valence CASSCF (GAMESS, 6-311G*) on diiodoacetylene across six charge states. One fixed 12-orbital space (8 pi + 4 sigma) with the electron count stepping 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11 from neutral to pentacation radical. Six rows. The tetracation is the headline: the smallest organic tetracation observed in the gas phase.

CASSCF(12,12)/CASPT2(12,12) with DMRG up to (20,18) (MOLPRO, Gaussian 09) on p-quinodimethane monomers and dimerisation intermediates in PPV Gilch-route polymerisation, used because DFT cannot describe their diradical character. One row; ground_state_mult left empty since the singlet-triplet ordering is the quantity under investigation.
CASPT2//CASSCF (MOLCAS 7.4) on the indole chromophore with the whole pi system active, (10,9). One row. Notable as a case needing no active-space justification beyond the chromophore itself.

CASSCF+PT2 on Cp*2Yb(4,5-diazafluorene). Documents an explicit equivalence test: CAS(4,4) with 2f + 2 lowest pi* gives results similar to CAS(12,8) with 6f + 2 pi*, so the smaller space was adopted. Two open-shell singlets lie below the triplet, and the magnetism is a Boltzmann equilibrium between them; metal_ox_state left empty because the ground state is an intermediate-valence mixture. One row.

CASSCF/CASPT2 with ELF/QTAIM analysis on oxygenated dinuclear copper enzyme models. The six active orbitals are individually named by symmetry label (O2 sigma/sigma*, two pi*, and the odd/even Cu combinations) but the active electron count is never stated, so nel is left empty. The paper is explicit that the space was sized for comparability with DFT geometries rather than for accuracy.

CASSCF/icMRCI (MOLPRO) on C3H, C5H and their anions for astrochemical characterisation. C5H has an explicit 13 active orbitals (upper five sigma and eight pi, with ten sigma and two pi frozen); C3H is specified only as full valence. Electron counts are never given for either, so nel is empty on both rows and the paper is marked partial. Two rows.

CERES code paper (CAHF/CASCI-SO) with a 40-molecule lanthanide benchmark set. Active space stated explicitly per lanthanide: seven 4f orbitals with 8 electrons in Tb, 9 in Dy, 10 in Ho, 11 in Er. Four rows condensed per lanthanide since the space depends only on 4f^n, not the ligand set.

RASSCF/CASPT2 global ground-state PES for O3, used for QCT dissociation cross-sections. Exemplary active-space provenance: five combinations (12e/9o, 12e/7o, 12e/12o, 18e/15o, 18e/12o) were tested near the transition region and (12,9) with only the O 2p orbitals was adopted on a stated accuracy-versus-cost basis. One row.

CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLPRO) excitation spectra of free-base porphin and Mg-porphin against CIS/RPA/ZINDO/TDDFT/SAC-CI. Only Gouterman's four-orbital model (4,4) is recorded numerically, with its orbitals named by irrep; the enlarged models B and C are described in the protocol but their bracketed labels are ambiguous as to electrons versus orbitals, so they are not converted. Valuable negative evidence: the authors conclude their own CAS treatment is insufficient even for the lowest transitions. Two rows.

CASSCF/RASSCF with CASPT2/RASPT2 (MOLCAS 7.6, ANO-RCC) assessing covalency in uranium and cerium hexachlorides. The RAS partition is fully specified - Cl 2p in RAS1, metal 4f/5f in RAS2, metal 5d/6d in RAS3, with double excitations only from RAS1 and into RAS3 - but no (nel,norb) pair or per-subspace counts appear, so the numeric fields are empty and this is partial. Three rows for the uranium complexes whose states and bond lengths are tabulated. The RAS1/RAS2/RAS3 assignment is a reusable template for f-element covalency studies.

Four-component multireference benchmark of spin-orbit coupling on p-block ELEMENTS. The 4c-CASSCF active space is 4 orbitals corresponding to the valence s and p orbitals of a free atom; the systems are atoms, not compounds, so this is excluded on the same scope convention applied to the Li atom/dimer paper and the free-atom polarizability paper earlier in this batch series. Logged so it converts if the scope rule is relaxed.

SA-CASSCF/icMRCI+Q (Molpro-2010) study of the thermodynamic stability of the VH2+ dication, with a fully specified active space - (6,2,2,1) per C2v symmetry species covering V 3s, 3p, 4s and 3d, 12 electrons distributed in all possible ways - and Breit-Pauli spin-orbit treatment. Excluded on scope only: VH2+ is a bare diatomic, and the standing convention in this database excludes diatomics and free atoms while admitting triatomics and larger (SO2+ and O3 were recorded in this same batch). The active space is fully recoverable if that rule is relaxed.

QM/MM CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS-6, Gaussian-03, AMBER-8 via COBRAMM) on adenine photostability in DNA. Deliberate two-space protocol: CASSCF(8,7) - one n, 3 pi, 3 pi* - for optimisations, extended to (8,8) at S0/Lb minima, with a larger (12,10) space (2n, 4pi, 4pi*) for the CASPT2/MSPT2 energies averaged over 6 singlets. A second row for the stacked adenine homodimer at (8,8) built symmetrically as 2pi+2pi* on each base. Two rows.

CASSCF/icMRCI with CCSD(T)-F12b (MOLPRO) on the [H,C,As] singlet and triplet surfaces. Active space stated as all possible excitations of ten electrons in a valence space given per symmetry as (5,2,2,0) linear and (7,2) bent, both 9 orbitals. Two rows for HCAs and HAsC.

CASSCF/CASPT2 with embedded fragment ab initio model potentials (MOLCAS 7.0) for dopant sites in solids. Two contrasting spaces in one paper: (25,17) for the Cr system including the 2p orbitals of four coordinating oxygens, and a minimal metal-only double-shell (5,10) for the Mn ligand-field states with 24 quartet roots. Two rows, embedded-cluster models recorded on the same basis as the Cu(111) surface rows.

SA-CASSCF with ab initio ligand field theory (ORCA 4.2, DKH) on a heptanuclear Ni4Dy3 aggregate, with diamagnetic substitution (Ni->Zn, Dy->Lu) so each paramagnetic ion is computed alone. CAS(8,5) for Ni and CAS(9,7) for Dy. Two rows.

SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2 (ORCA 6.1.1) on ferromagnetic Ni(II)-M(IV)-Ni(II) clathrochelate trimers. Active space five d orbitals with the electron count and multiplet number DETERMINED from the 3d8 configuration (10 triplets), i.e. the full manifold rather than a truncation. One row.

SA-CASSCF with QDPT spin-orbit (ORCA, DKH2, extended TZVP) on pentacoordinate complexes. The stated active space is eight electrons in five metal d orbitals with all 10 triplet and 15 singlet states equally weighted, i.e. the d8 case; the paper's title spans d5 to d9 but only the d8 space is stated, so only that is recorded. One row.

CASSCF/CASPT2 excited-state absorption for conjugated oligomers, benchmarked against quadratic-response TD-DFT. The SI contains an explicit active-space size study - 8/8, 10/10, 12/12, 14/14 compared against experimental energies and oscillator strengths - with 10/10 adopted for the phenylenevinylenes and 14/14 for the oligothiophenes so the in-plane sulfur MO pair is included. States the method's practical ceiling at about 18/18. Four rows.

SA-CASSCF/CASPT2 with AMFI-DKH spin-orbit and RASSI-SO (MOLCAS) on the Ce(III) dopant site in Lu2SiO5, for the 4f->5d transitions underlying the LSO:Ce scintillator. Active space named as [4f,5d,6s] - 13 orbitals - holding the single 4f1 electron; including both 4f and 5d manifolds in one space is what allows the interconfigurational transition to be described. One row.

CASSCF and DFT (Gaussian 03, ORCA) on (C5Me5)2Yb(3,3'-Me2-bipy), studying how the bipyridine torsion angle controls Yb intermediate valence (nf = 0.86). The active space is named by orbital content - Yb 4f plus four empty bipy pi* orbitals - but no electron or orbital counts are given, so the numeric fields are empty and this is partial. metal_ox_state also empty: the ground state is an intermediate-valence mixture.

Electronic structure of first- and second-row ATOMS under harmonic confinement. The systems are free atoms in a model confining potential, excluded on the standing scope convention that free atoms and bare diatomics are not 'a specific chemical compound'; consistent with the p-block atom benchmark and the Li atom/dimer paper marked not_usable earlier in this batch series.

Self-interaction corrected density functional theory for intramolecular electron transfer dynamics in radical carbocations. The computational content is SIC-DFT and Ehrenfest dynamics; no CASSCF/CASPT2 calculation is performed and no active space is stated anywhere in the text.

Luminescent single-molecule magnets as dual magneto-optical molecular thermometers. CASSCF results are referenced from previously reported work (reference 62) and the authors state they also conducted such calculations, but no active space, root count or basis is given anywhere in the main text, and no SI is reachable via figshare or PMC. Retry if the SI becomes available.

Preprint/published duplicate. This chemRxiv preprint (10.26434/chemrxiv-2023-296cq) is the same study as W4389180090, the published Chem. Eur. J. version (10.1002/chem.202302970), which was mined separately - same compound, same CAS(4,3) over the P2C pi system, same CAS(2,2)/CAS(10,9) sensitivity checks. Detected by the title-prefix dedup scan run 2026-07-31. Resolution per standing rule: equal row counts, so the published DOI is kept as citation of record; this preprint's row W4386626210-a has been removed and its non-empty fields merged into the surviving row, with both DOIs recorded in that row's notes.

SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2 (ORCA 5.0.3, DKH) on six tetracoordinate Co(II) complexes forming a 2x3 matrix: two heterocyclic ligands (2-amino-1-methyl-benzimidazole L1, 4-methylquinoline L2) crossed with three halides (Cl, Br, I). Identical (7,5) active space and 10 quartet / 40 doublet root set throughout. Six rows.

CASSCF with CASPT2 energies on the diagonal of the spin-orbit Hamiltonian (MOLCAS 8, ANO). Two rows with instructively different spaces: minimal (8,5) Ni 3d for the Ni(II) complex, adopted on prior validation, versus (10,13) for [Fe(bpy)3]2+ where the standard spin-state space is extended by one bipyridine pi* specifically to describe MLCT.

State-specific CASSCF(6,5)/def2-TZVPP on an annulated 1,4-distibabenzene diradicaloid. Reports natural-orbital occupation patterns with weights (22200 at 95%, 21111 at 3%) rather than a single configuration, and gives diradical character of the dication as 36% (SS-CASSCF) versus 39% (UHF). One row.

CASSCF(8,7)/def2-SV(P) in MOLPRO used solely to locate S0/S1 minimum energy conical intersections for two pyridone-tautomer fluorophores, with all energetics from TD-DFT. Two rows. A clear division-of-labour case: the active space needs to describe the crossing, not the spectrum.

SA3-CASSCF(10,8)/6-31G(d) with CASPT2 and nonadiabatic dynamics (MOLPRO 2018.1) on trans-4,4'-azopyridine photoisomerization; space is four occupied pi, one n and three pi*, with a larger SA3-CASSCF(14,12) run specifically to confirm the located minima. One row. Checked explicitly against the cis-4,4'-azopyridine paper already in the database (10.1063/5.0313670) - different isomer, DOI, journal and year, so companion work rather than a duplicate.

CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS-3) characterization of the low-lying excited states of the CuCl molecule, with a fully specified active space (3d, 3d', 4s orbitals, 11 electrons for Cu and 10 for Cu+, extended by one Cl 3p orbital for some states) and CASPT2(v) versus CASPT2(c-v) correlation analysis. Excluded on scope only: CuCl is a bare diatomic, and the standing convention in this database excludes diatomics and free atoms. Fully recoverable if that rule is relaxed.

CASSCF/CASPT2 with RASSI and QTAIM analysis of f-orbital covalency across the actinocene series AnCOT2, An = Th to Cm. One fixed 16-orbital active space - COT pi donors plus the actinide 7f and 6d manifolds - held constant across all seven members with only the electron count changing, 8 (Th) to 14 (Cm), written CASSCF(n,16). Seven rows. ThCOT2 and NpCOT2 also appear in this database from other papers with different DOIs; those are independent studies.

DFT study of the mechanism of 1,4,2,3-dithiadiazinane formation by head-to-head [3+3] cyclodimerization of thiocarbonyl S-imides. CASSCF results are invoked to postulate delocalized diradicals as stepwise intermediates, but no active space size, basis or software for the CASSCF step appears anywhere in the main text, and no SI is reachable via figshare or PMC. The paper's own computational content is DFT with ELF and NBO analysis.

Lanthanide series study with SA-CASSCF/RASSI-SO computations on X-ray structures of complexes 3-7, confirming trivalent electronic structure. The paper states explicitly that computational methods are in the supplement; the SI fetch returned only a coordinates file (om1c00590_si_002.xyz), not the methods document, so no active space, root count or basis is recoverable. Retry if the methods SI becomes reachable.

CASSCF/CASPT2 versus the semiempirical radial effective charge model on Na5[Ln(oda)3](H2O)6(BF4)2, Ln = Dy and Er (DyODA, ErODA), testing predictive power against spectroscopic and magnetic data. Scientifically interesting as negative evidence - the authors conclude complete-active-space methods reproduce the magnetic properties reasonably but FAIL to account for the energy level distribution - but no active space, root count or basis is stated in the main text and no SI is reachable, so no row can be written without inferring the space.

Positional isomers of isocyanoazulenes as axial ligands on ruthenium(II) tetraphenylporphyrin. The computational content is DFT and TDDFT (Gouterman porphyrin-centred excitations); no CASSCF or other multireference calculation is performed and no active space is stated anywhere.

Nature Chemistry study using CASSCF//NEVPT2 to assign the 400 nm pump transition in a transient absorption experiment on Mn(acac)3 and related d3/d5 systems. The active space is given only in Supplementary Table 3, and no SI is reachable via figshare or PMC, so nothing can be recorded without inferring it. Retry if the SI becomes available.

CASSCF/icMRCI on C7, C7- and C7+ (GAUSSIAN 09 for structures, MOLPRO for the correlated work). One fixed 13-orbital space - upper three sigma_g, four pi_u, two sigma_u and four pi_g - with the electron count 12/13/11 across neutral, anion and cation. Three rows.

QM(CASPT2//CASSCF):MM(AMBER) study of thymine-thymine (6-4) adduct formation in DNA. Three nested active spaces for three jobs: CASPT2(12,10) for energies (10 singlet + 10 triplet SA), CASSCF(8,6) for most optimisations, and CASSCF(4,4) at the 3n-pi*-T' minimum specifically because the (8,6) computation did not converge there. One row; the convergence-forced reduction is recorded in the protocol.

CASPT2//CASSCF plus CASSCF classical dynamics on nitrobenzene photodegradation and roaming (OpenMolcas, ANO-L). (16,13) for all final CASPT2 verticals, reduced (14,11) for geometry optimisations, frequencies and dynamics; both spaces cover the pi system and the oxygen lone pairs. One row.

CASSCF with QDPT spin-orbit (ORCA) on closo-carborane-based Co(II) single-ion complexes with O, S, Se and Te bridging atoms. Active space seven electrons over five 3d orbitals giving ten S=3/2 and forty S=1/2 configurations; S=3/2 ground state throughout before SOC. Four rows organised by bridging chalcogen.

CASSCF (GAMESS) on singlet-dioxygen addition to hydroxyaromatics, using a (10,8) space that the authors state is needed to get the OOO moiety geometry right. Two rows: the 1,3-butadiene-1-ol model system and the phenol-dioxygen system. Reports NEGATIVE evidence against both peroxa and endoperoxide intermediates.

SA-CASSCF and MS-CASPT2 (MOLCAS 7.0, ANO) on phenol, computing two-dimensional coherent optical spectroscopy signals. CASSCF(8,7); the two levels give measurably different 2DCS predictions (anharmonicity -0.57 vs -0.62 eV, doubly excited state numbered 10A' vs 11A'). One row.

CASSCF/RASSI-SO (OpenMolcas) on four mononuclear Dy(III) complexes of tris(2-hydroxybenzylidene)triaminoguanidine. Active space (9,7) with the COMPLETE f9 manifold as roots - 21 sextets, 224 quartets, 490 doublets. A controlled comparison: complex 1 (D5h, seven-coordinate) is not an SMM while 2-4 (D2d, eight-coordinate) are, at identical active space. Four rows.

CASSCF (MOLCAS, ANO-DK3, DKH) on the Cf(III) site in Cf[B6O8(OH)5], predicting the crystal-field splitting of the 6H ground term. Same active space run with two different state selections - all 21 sextets of the high-spin 5f9 configuration versus only the 6H states - to test sensitivity to the averaged manifold. ELF analysis shows O-to-Cf electron donation with about half the extra charge entering 6d. One row.

SA-CASSCF surfaces for the 3A'' and 3A' states of O(3P) + HBr, with DKH2 and core-valence corrections. The active space is described as full valence EXCLUDING the oxygen and bromine s valence orbitals, and three A' plus three A'' states are averaged, but no electron or orbital counts are printed, so the numeric fields are empty and this is marked partial. Recorded because the targeted exclusion rule is itself informative.

SA-CASSCF/MRCI study of the diatomic dication SiC2+ in the gas phase (GAMESS-US, GUGA). Excluded on scope only: SiC2+ is a bare diatomic, and the standing convention in this database excludes diatomics and free atoms while admitting triatomics and larger. The active space is recoverable if that rule is relaxed.

SA-CASSCF/MRCI potential energy curves, transition moments and radiative lifetimes for the low-lying states of BeCl, with a fully specified active space - 9 electrons in a (5,2,2,0) space in the C2v Abelian subgroup, Be 1s correlated in the MRCI but not active. Excluded on scope only: BeCl is a bare diatomic, consistent with the CuCl, SiC2+ and VH2+ exclusions in this batch series. Fully recoverable if the rule is relaxed.

Science paper on metal-organic magnets with large coercivity and ordering temperatures up to 242 C. The work is synthetic, structural and magnetometric; no CASSCF or other multireference calculation appears in the text and no active space is stated.

CASSCF/icMRCI with RCCSD(T) (MOLPRO, GAUSSIAN 09) on C6N, C6N- and C6N+ for astrochemistry. Active spaces stated per charge state: 13 orbitals / 17 electrons neutral, 12 orbitals / 18 electrons anion, 13 orbitals / 16 electrons cation - note the ORBITAL count changes for the anion, unlike the fixed-orbital charge series elsewhere in this database. Three rows.

CASSCF/CASPT2 on embedded cluster models of the RbCo[Fe(CN)6] Prussian blue analogue (MOLCAS 7.2, ANO, Douglas-Kroll, 0.50 a.u. level shift). Exemplary stepwise active-space construction: CAS[10,12] built from the valence 6-electron/5-d-MO space for Co(III), extended by the 3d' double shell and by the ligand-field orbitals whose occupation changes between S=0 and S=2. The paper states a 10e/12o space is REQUIRED for a d6 ion at CASPT2. One row.

CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS, ANO-L) on the magnetic anisotropy of [Mo(CN)7]4- and fragments of cyano-bridged networks. Minimal ligand-field active space of five d orbitals holding the three Mo(III) valence electrons, i.e. (3,5) - a 4d ion treated with the same minimal (n,5) space normally used for 3d. One row.

Full-valence CASCI on state-averaged CASSCF orbitals for double-core-hole and Auger final states of OCS. The active space is specified only as full valence with no printed counts, so the numeric fields are empty and this is partial. Recorded chiefly for the root counts, which are by far the largest in this database: 8, 11 and 14 states for the O1s-1/C1s-1/S2p-1 CVV channels and 18000 singlets plus 18000 triplets for the VVVV manifold.

CASSCF combined with TD-DFT (ORCA) on heteroatom-doped [Fe@Au8(PPh3)8]4+ gold nanoclusters showing high-spin (multiplicity 5) / low-spin (multiplicity 3) isomerism tied to different Au8 core geometries (C2 vs D2). The PDF text is heavily de-spaced through the computational section and no (nel,norb) pair is recoverable with confidence, so the numeric fields are left empty and this is partial.

SA-CASSCF/MRCI on the hydroxyl dication OH2+, with a fully specified active space - (6,3,3,0) by symmetry with six electrons correlated in all possible ways - and dissociation energies for the low-lying states. Excluded on scope only: OH2+ is a bare diatomic, consistent with the CuCl, BeCl, SiC2+, VH2+ exclusions across this batch series. Fully recoverable if the diatomic rule is relaxed.

SA-CASSCF/icMRCI (Molpro-2009) on the SiAs diatomic, full-valence (4,2,2,0) active space distributing all valence electrons (Si 3s3p, As 4s4p), with Breit-Pauli spin-orbit eigenstates and reference-space dimensions reported per symmetry. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomic.

CASSCF/MRCI on ScS and ScS+ using a (5,2,2,1) active space with seven electrons distributed in all possible ways, with reference-space dimensions given per symmetry. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomics.

CASSCF/MRCI (ORCA) potential energy curves for He2 and He2+ with machine-learning extrapolation; active orbitals stated as 3 sigma_g, 3 sigma_u, 2 pi_g, 2 pi_u. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomics of a single element.

CASSCF/MRSDCI (Molpro-2006, aug-cc-pV5Z-PP) characterization of the low-lying electronic states of BeAs, with an active space of 12 orbitals (6,3,3,0) including three extra correlating orbitals beyond the valence set. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomic.

The extracted text is a BOOK INDEX (subject index pages listing angular overlap model, EPR, electronic structures of free ions, etc.), not a research article. No calculation, no compound, no active space. Not a usable source.

PCA-assisted spectral reconstruction of Nd(III) DOTA and pDO3A speciation. CASSCF with spin-orbit coupling is described as effective for Ln(III) complexes and the authors compare against such electronic structure, but no active space, root count, basis or software for a CASSCF calculation performed here is stated anywhere in the text, and no SI is reachable.

CASSCF(8,8)+NEVPT2/aug-cc-pVTZ on the C-C bond rupture of C2F4, testing a dative versus electron-sharing description. Notable for using a MODIFIED AVAS (atomic valence active space) automated selection - core orbitals excluded from the projection step, occupied/virtual threshold split - rather than a hand-picked space. One row.

CASSCF (Gaussian 92, 4-31G) plus MMVB on the S0/S1 surfaces of pentalene. Full pi valence space: eight electrons in eight pi MOs, with the CASSCF wavefunction describing all possible occupations. Historically interesting as an explicit attempt to build a cheap surrogate (MMVB, MM2 sigma framework plus parametrised Heisenberg Hamiltonian for the active orbitals) that reproduces a specific CASSCF space to within 0.01 A in bond lengths. One row.

CASSCF plus DFT on Cp'2Th(bipy), answering whether it is a low-valent thorium complex. It is not: the ground state is Th(IV)(bipy2-), f0d0(pi*)2, S=0, with an open-shell singlet f0d1(pi*)1 only 9.2 kcal/mol higher and thermally accessible, explaining the observed temperature-independent paramagnetism. CASSCF was introduced specifically because DFT biases towards the closed-shell configuration. No active space size is stated anywhere, so the numeric fields are empty and this is partial.

German-language Angewandte paper on NHC-stabilised B2P2 rings from addition of a diphosphane to a B-B triple bond. CASSCF/NEVPT2 gives a LUMO natural occupation of 0.41 electrons for the planar dication isomer, quantifying substantial diradicaloid character alongside a small singlet-triplet gap. No (nel,norb) pair appears in the extracted text, so the numeric fields are empty and this is partial.

CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS, ANO-RCC-VTZP, second-order Douglas-Kroll-Hess) potential energy surfaces for an antiproton approaching common biological functional groups, for particle-beam cancer therapy. The text states the active space selection 'is described below' but no size, orbital composition or counts survive in the extracted text, and no SI is reachable, so no row can be written without inferring the space.

Perspective/review by Swart, 'Spin States of (Bio)inorganic Systems: Successes and Pitfalls'. TD-DFT study of photo-excitation of dinucleoside radical cations. No multireference calculation is performed here.

SA-CASSCF/MRCI on the CI diatomic with active space (4,2,2,0) comprising the carbon 2s, 2p and 3s orbitals and the iodine 5p orbital. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomic. Fully recoverable if the rule is relaxed.

SA-CASSCF/MRCI on the SrBr and SrI diatomics, mixing all doublet and quartet states, with active spaces (7,2,2,0) formed by the Sr 4s/4p/5s/6s orbitals plus the halogen valence orbitals. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomics.
CASSCF/MRCI on the SeI diatomic with a (4,3,3,0) active space including the Se 4s/4p and I 5p orbitals, for both doublet and quartet states. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomic.

SA-CASSCF/MRCI (MOLPRO) characterization of the potentially new molecular species MgAs, with all valence electrons in an 11-orbital (5,3,3,0) active space in C2v. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomic.

CASSCF/CASPT2 (MOLCAS 5 prerelease) on uranium triatomics XUY (X,Y = C,N,O). Active space built by explicit ligand/metal orbital PAIRING: six O/C/N 2p orbitals each matched to a U-centred correlating orbital of the same symmetry (linear combinations of 5f, 6d, 7s), giving (12,12) partitioned (4,4,4,0) in C2v for the U(VI) members; the U(V) space is derived from it by adding an electron, deleting one weakly occupied a1 orbital and adding a 5f orbital in b1, giving (13,12) partitioned (3,5,4,0). Four rows: OUO, NUN, CUO, NUO.

CASSCF(14,13)/CASPT2(14,13)/cc-pVTZ (MOLCAS 6.2) on cyanoacetylene photodissociation, relevant to Titan haze chemistry; (14,13) is all valence orbitals except the low sigma set, with a reduced CASSCF(8,8) used for crossing-point optimisation. One row.

CASSCF(8,8) plus several DFT functionals on cyclo[18]carbon. Notable negative agreement: attempts to optimise the cumulenic geometry always yield a saddle point with imaginary frequencies at every level including CASSCF(8,8) (1900i cm-1), with alternating bond lengths 1.199/1.356 A. One row.

CASSCF at two space sizes on bent and cyclic NO2 (GAUSSIAN 98, 6-31+G(d)). One row recording the larger space with both in the protocol.

CASSCF with 12 electrons in 12 orbitals on EDO-TTF, checked against ANO-S. Rare explicit statement of the CRITERION for where to truncate the active space: HF orbital energies were inspected and HOMO-3 to HOMO-5, lying within 0.41 eV of each other, were kept together rather than split. One row.

CASSCF/6-31G(d) (GAUSSIAN 94/98) vibrational analysis supporting femtosecond spectroscopy of DMABN. The space is described by orbital content, not counts - two highest occupied and two lowest unoccupied a and b orbitals in C2v, with the amino nitrogen lone pair ADDED for the TICT structures - so numeric fields are empty and this is partial. CASSCF/CASPT2 on the actinide arene-metalate U(eta6-C14H10)2(HMPA)(THF), concluding the U-C bonding consists SOLELY of pi-interactions, distinct from classic actinide sandwich complexes. CASSCF/MRCI on aluminium monobromide and monoiodide, 14 valence electrons in 12 active orbitals composed of 4 sigma [Al 4s, 3p0, 3d0, 4p0], 6 pi [Al 3p+-1, 3d+-1, 4p+-1] and 2 delta orbitals. Excluded on scope only: bare diatomics. Fully recoverable if the rule is relaxed.

German-language 'Trendbericht Theoretische Chemie' (trends report) in Nachrichten aus der Chemie - a survey article on developments in theoretical chemistry, not a research paper. No specific compound, calculation or active space.

CASSCF(6+n,9) single-point energies verifying B3LYP/LANL2DZ spin-state assignments for the ten first-row [TM-O2]2+ dications, TM = Sc to Zn.
