off-topic conference abstract (IAGG 2017 World Congress) on pioneering a medication self-administration program in a hospital rehabilitation setting. No chemistry; a keyword collision.
off-topic higher-education policy: 'Impact of Implementing the Third Mission of Universities in Africa (ITMUA)'. No chemistry; a keyword collision.

radiative charge transfer in cold and ultracold collisions of sulfur atoms with protons, i.e. the SH+ diatomic system: MRCI potential curves and transition dipoles feeding cross sections. Bare diatomic, excluded by the standing convention.

elastic scattering of ruthenium atoms from Si and O atoms at 2-200 eV: binary interatomic Ru-Ru, Ru-Si and Ru-O pair potentials, the Ru-O one from MRCI/AV5Z. All the multireference work is on bare diatomic pairs, excluded by the standing convention, and the paper reports scattering cross sections rather than an active space.

Russian-language original (Pisma v ZhTF 49(9), 2023) of the same work as W4385338892, the English Technical Physics Letters translation: elastic scattering of ruthenium atoms from Si and O with MRCI/AV5Z Ru-O pair potentials. Duplicate record, and excluded on the same bare-diatomic ground.

benchmark of dynamic-correlation models built on seniority-zero (AP1roG-type) wavefunctions, tested on closed-shell reaction energies and on multiple bond breaking in the N2, C2 and BN dimers. The multireference numbers (CASSCF, MRCI-SD, MRCI-SD+Q) are literature reference data taken from Peterson et al. rather than calculations of the authors' own, and the three test systems are bare diatomics excluded by the standing convention. No active space of the authors' own to record.

static dipole moments and electronic structure of the low-lying electronic states of the ZnSe molecule: CASSCF followed by MRCI using the full CASSCF configuration space as reference, with an ECP28MWB effective core potential on Se. Bare diatomic, excluded by the standing convention.

quantum dynamics of rotational transitions in CN(X2Sigma+) induced by H+ collisions: rigid-rotor ground-state surface of the 1 2Sigma+/1 2A' symmetry computed at internally contracted MRCI/cc-pVTZ in MOLPRO 2010.1 over 780 geometries with the CN bond fixed at 2.23 a0. The CASSCF reference is never characterized - no active space, orbital list or state averaging is stated anywhere - so there is nothing to record under copy-never-infer.

wavefunction-based treatment of excited-state electron correlation in periodic systems, with trans-polyacetylene as the test system: local incremental MRCI(SD) band structure on Hartree-Fock orbitals. Same approach and system as W2133871103, already ruled out here: the correlation treatment defines no complete active space and no (nel,norb) can be recorded.

tensor factorized Hamiltonian downfolding (TFHD) and its qubitized quantum analogue: a formal method/complexity paper deriving orbital-wise downfolding expressions and their quantum-circuit implementation, with case studies phrased as operator formalisms (multireference downfolding with singles and paired doubles, unitary multireference downfolding, single-configuration spin-restricted downfolding). No specific chemical compound is computed and no (nel,norb) active space is stated anywhere.

arXiv preprint (10.48550/arxiv.2304.12927) of W4376133274 (10.1039/d3cp01464a), the published PCCP version already read and mined: same Li + CaF -> Ca + LiF study, SA-CASSCF full-valence (10e,9o) plus icMRCI+Q with cc-pwCVQZ-PP on Ca. Row W4376133274-a already carries this work - preprint/published double-counting rule, published version kept.
off-topic French-language education paper on developing an assessment policy for a learning programme. No chemistry; a keyword collision.

high-energy reaction dynamics of N3: reactive surface for N2(1Sigma_g+) + N(4S) built from multistate CASSCF(15,12) + MRCI-F12/AVTZ-F12 energies (RKHS fit, 5481 points) and compared with a CASPT2/mAVQZ PIP surface on a CAS(9,9) reference, MOLPRO, 8 state-averaged states (two per spin state and symmetry), plus QCT rate simulations. One row.

ab initio surfaces and close-coupling dynamics for rotational excitation of CS by H+: CASSCF with 10 electrons in active orbitals of 6-12 a' and 1-2 a'' symmetry, then icMRCI with aug-cc-pVQZ, states 1-3 1Sigma+/1A' depending on approach geometry. One row for the HCS+ collision complex. Partial because the active orbital count is given as symmetry ranges rather than a number.

equilibrium structure of NO2 redetermined by several routes: MRCI+Q (relaxed-reference Davidson) on a CASSCF(23e,15o) space spanning all core and valence orbitals, all electrons correlated, aug-cc-pwCVnZ n = D-5 in Molpro, against CCSD(T)/CCSDT/CCSDTQ and semiexperimental methods, with B3LYP rovibrational corrections. One row carrying the recommended r(NO) = 1.1944(6) A and angle(ONO) = 133.89(11) degrees.

off-topic pharmacology: in vitro evaluation of 4-methoxyresorcinol and kaempferol 7-O-rutinoside with molecular docking in Autodock Vina. Yet another MRCI collision - here 'MRCI' is the authors' label for an iodinated isolate (K7RI and MRCI), not multireference CI. No quantum-chemical active space.

umbrella sampling for excited states using a semiempirical method: free-energy sampling of photoisomerization with semiempirical MRCI on the orthogonalization-corrected OM2 Hamiltonian. No ab initio CASSCF-family calculation, out of scope like the other pure OM2/MRCI papers in this queue.

new chlorophylls designed by theoretical spectroscopy and machine learning: candidate screening with TD-DFT and DFT/MRCI (Kleinschmidt et al. Hamiltonian) on PM6-preoptimized structures. DFT/MRCI builds its reference by selection with no complete active space stated, matching the other DFT/MRCI papers ruled out here.

cold collisions in heteronuclear alkali/alkaline-earth atom-ion systems: multireference potential curves for the diatomic ion pairs feeding cold-collision cross sections. Bare diatomics, excluded by the standing convention.

state-specific ion mobilities of Lr+ (Z = 103) in helium: relativistic multireference interaction potentials for the Lr+-He pair. A bare diatomic interaction pair, excluded by the standing convention.

transport property predictions for laser resonance chromatography of Rf+ (Z = 104) in helium: relativistic multireference Rf+-He interaction potentials feeding mobility calculations. Bare diatomic pair, excluded by the standing convention.
theoretical study of infrared and ultraviolet spectroscopy of SiP as an interstellar species: MRCI potential and dipole curves for the diatomic. Excluded by the standing bare-diatomic convention.
